findings.claim: POSITIVE VERIFICATION: every named entity in the current passage was independently re-checked against live sources and none has a real bearer in a related domain. The collision the repair was opened for is genuinely gone.
findings.evidence: Skolverkets skolenhetsregister pulled live 2026-08-04 (api.skolverket.se/skolenhetsregistret/v1/skolenhet, 10 630 units — the count the originality_note states): substring probes 'Klöverhag', 'Häggnora', 'Fagerhammar', 'Ödsberga', 'Tjärnfeldt' -> 0 hits each. sv-Wikipedia CirrusSearch insource:// -> Klöverhagsskolan 0, Klöverhagen 0, Häggnora 0, Fagerhammar 0, Ödsberga 0, Tjärnfeldt 0; en-Wikipedia insource -> 0 for all six. Wikidata wbsearchentities (sv) -> no entity for any of the five names (only unrelated Danish 'Kløverhage', Q23752175, a point in Denmark, on the truncated stem). Exa semantic search for 'Klöverhagsskolan grundskola kommun', 'Häggnora ort by gård', 'Ödsberga plats ort', 'Tjärnfeldt efternamn' returned only near-names (Klockarhagsskolan, Klöverträskskolan, Häggum/Häggvik/Häggenäs, Östberga/Ödsby, Tjerneld/Tjernlund/Järnefelt) — no exact bearer. Passage entity set checked in full: Häggnora (kommun), Fagerhammar (centralkök), Klöverhagsskolan (school), Ödsberga (grannkommun), Birgitta Tjärnfeldt (byline). No firm, institute or publication is named anywhere in the text.
findings.why: The two cautionary precedents in this campaign (a kept name that turned out to be a real Slovenian firm; a sweep that mis-classified two real Swedish places) do not repeat here — each replacement was re-derived from primary registers by this audit, not taken on the repair's word.

findings.claim: POSITIVE VERIFICATION: rationale quotes, trap labels and internal cross-references all resolve against the current post-rename text.
findings.evidence: Passage-quoted spans in the rationales resolve verbatim: 'räknar på fel sak', 'något som ingen kalkyl fångar', 'märkningen av allergener blir säkrare', 'fyra kronor är fyra kronor', 'tycktes matsvinnet öka — men framför allt hos de lägre klasserna, och nästan bara när det var lagad varm mat'. The two non-verbatim quoted spans ('aldrig ... i varje skolas eget kök', 'alla elever, oavsett rätt') are compressed citations of options q1-A and q2-B, not of the passage, and both are unchanged from the pre-repair file. Cross-references post-rename: q2 stem toponym == passage toponym (Ödsberga); the q2-C rationale now says 'Häggnoras kalkyl', matching the passage's 'fyra kronor mindre' in Häggnora; byline 'skolkock i Häggnora' matches the writer's Klöverhagsskolan employment inside Häggnora; q2-C 'de tre försöksskolorna' matches 'där tre skolor gick över'. self_blind_solve now lists exactly the five new names. planted_traps and key_spread ['B','D'] match the rationales and keys.

findings.evidence: verdicts-gstem.jsonl (lines 5-6), verdicts-gkey-1.jsonl (21-22), verdicts-gkey-2.jsonl (21-22) and verdicts-gdistractor.jsonl (21-22) all end with '-entityfix' lines for las-b2-002. verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl contains 40 lines with executed_by tags {G-KEY-vfinal: 32, G-KEY-regate: 4, G-KEY-declone: 4} and ZERO entityfix lines; its last las-b2-002 records are lines 21-22, tagged 'claude-opus-4-8/G-KEY-vfinal' (pre-rename). vfinal_fold.py:61 reads gkey solely from verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl via _last_wins. The sibling declone repair DID propagate into that file (las-b2-003 declone lines at 19-20 and 39-40), so this is a deviation from the directory's own convention. git status confirms the entityfix round modified gdistractor/gkey-1/gkey-2/gstem but not gkey-resolved. reviews/final_verify.jsonl's las-b2-002 record (2026-07-30) reads 'gkey_records=4 ... audit=CONFIRMED audit_major=0 audit_minor=0', i.e. it also predates this audit file.

Same class of staleness already recorded for las-b2-003.

findings.stage_challenged: originality_note (collision evidence for the retired name)
findings.claim: The originality_note's count of the Sörgårdsskolan collision is not reproducible as written: it says the register lists 'four real school units with that exact name (Mölndal, Gislaved, Vällingby/Stockholm plus Fritidshemmet Sörgården)'. The live register holds FIVE units with the exact name plus two differently-named Sörgården fritidshem.
findings.evidence: Live pull 2026-08-04 (10 630 units): 'Sörgårdsskolan' appears 5x, all Aktiv, kommunkod 0180 (Stockholm), 0662 (Gislaved), 0665 (Vaggeryd), 1481 (Mölndal), 2380 (Östersund); additionally 'Fritidshemmet Sörgården' (kommunkod 1765, Vilande) and 'Sörgårdens fritidshem' (1452, Vilande) — neither carries the exact name the note attributes to it. The adjacent claims about the replaced municipality reproduce exactly: 'Kvarnbyskolan' 2 units (1481 Mölndal, 0180 Stockholm); sv-Wikipedia confirms Kvarnby as a delområde in Husie, Malmö, with Kvarnby folkhögskola; 'Almvik, Västerviks kommun' is confirmed a real småort in Törnsfalls socken.
findings.why: The misstatement understates the collision it was written to justify, so the repair decision stands a fortiori — but the note is presented as a verification record and a later reader recomputing it will not land on 'four'. Reword to '5 exact units + 2 Sörgården fritidshem' if the note is kept as evidence.

findings.claim: One item in the REJECTED list is misclassified: 'Ekhamra and Kvistberga (real school units)' — Ekhamra checks out, Kvistberga does not appear in the school register at all.
findings.evidence: Register probe: 'Ekhamra' -> 1 unit ('Ekhamraskolan'); 'Kvistberga' -> 0 units. sv-Wikipedia has Kvistberga only as a place name in Västmanland/Södermanland road lists and a medieval Vadstena land record — a real toponym, not a school unit. Spot-checks of the other rejections all reproduce: Norrhammar -> 4 register units (Norrhammarskolan, 7-9, F-6, Resursskola Norrhammar); Bråtnäs naturreservat, Bengtsfors (sv-wiki); Näverbo and Hällmyra real places (sv-wiki); Sven Vallmark translator; Filip Tallhamn actor; Nybrink real Swedish journalists.
findings.why: The name was rejected either way, so no shipping consequence; recorded so the rejected-log is not later cited as register evidence it does not have.

findings.claim: 'Klöverhagsskolan' is clean as an exact name but its stem is the surname of landsfiskal Klöverhage, a recurring character across the Åsa-Nisse film series — a culturally salient Swedish fictional bearer the note does not mention.
findings.evidence: sv-Wikipedia insource:/Klöverhag/ -> 13 hits, all 'landsfiskal Klöverhage' in Åsa-Nisse film cast lists and actor articles (Gösta Prüzelius, Gösta Krantz, Willy Peters, Gösta Jonsson); en-Wikipedia insource -> 5 hits, same character. The exact strings the note certifies — 'Klöverhagsskolan' and 'Klöverhagen' — are genuinely 0/0/0 across sv-wiki, en-wiki and Wikidata, so no stated claim is false.
findings.why: Not a real-entity collision (a film character is not a real school, person or place), so no blocker. But the campaign already retires stems for weaker reasons ('Tegel-' was avoided because three names in las-b12-002 carry it — verified: Tegelhagen, Tegelsmora, Tegelsund), and a Swedish reader may hear an Åsa-Nisse echo in a school named Klöverhagsskolan. Owner call only.
